tasks.short: Consult stakeholders to determine computing needs and system requirements.

steps.what: Collect actual system context and prior user requests using native project source links
inputs: actual consultation scope
actual user requests and system records
outputs: scientist-checked consultation source context

steps.what: Consult actual users, managers, vendors and technicians to establish computing needs and constraints
inputs: scientist-checked consultation source context
actual stakeholder explanations and constraints
outputs: scientist-captured actual needs, disputed requirements and source-linked consultation notes

steps.what: Draft and substantively check system requirements against the actual consultation notes
inputs: scientist-captured actual needs, disputed requirements and source-linked consultation notes
outputs: scientist-checked complete candidate requirements record

loop.purpose: Express actual variable stakeholder needs as a candidate requirements record
loop.input: Actual scientist notes, sources, constraints and explicitly recorded disagreements
loop.output: Candidate requirements with source links and unresolved items kept explicit
loop.check: Scientist checks each requirement meaning, scope, obligation, omission and source against actual notes; no proposal becomes agreed merely through wording
loop.stop: Missing source intent or two failed corrections returns to manual requirements writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle fixed metadata first; varied user prose requires meaning-preserving requirement drafting and checking

steps.what: Approve the complete final requirements record and exact internal review recipients
inputs: scientist-checked complete candidate requirements record
outputs: approved final requirements record and exact internal reviewers

steps.what: Save the approved final requirements record
inputs: approved final requirements record and exact internal reviewers
outputs: saved final requirements record

steps.what: Send the approved final requirements record to the approved internal reviewers
inputs: approved final requirements record and exact internal reviewers
outputs: sent final requirements review request

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} source links to actual {HELPDESK} and {DOCS} context. The scientist conducts consultations and captures actual needs; a bounded drafting loop prepares candidate requirements with full meaning checks. The complete final record is approved before separate save and internal review send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual context is gathered repeatedly and variable consultation notes are rewritten into requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links reduce repeated retrieval; bounded drafting can preserve actual need statements with sources.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting needs, ambiguous requirements and distinguishing a preference from an agreed obligation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist asks questions that expose the real computing problem.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated requirements documentation after human consultation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked project records and bounded requirements drafting are feasible proposed components; no local saving is measured.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual context retrieval and requirement rewriting after current project templates; existing links and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual request records supply request_id, source_version and system_id. s1 retains 7.5 hours for context checking. s2 retains full capture of actual need_text, source_person, constraint, rationale and disputed_status. Missing actual intent is clarified manually; no stakeholder agreement is invented.

s3 retains 15 hours for full requirement meaning and omission checks. s4 approves the complete final record and exact internal reviewers; changes void approval. Consultation and review send remain full effort; same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which needs are still rewritten manually after existing requirement templates?

incremental.description: Maintain requirement source mappings and audit meaning fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final requirements record and exact internal reviewers

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross = 15 times 50% retrieval plus 25 times 40% prose = 17.5 less 2 upkeep = 15.5. Low changes half of retrieval only and leaves prose manual: 3.75 less 2 = 1.75.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and interpret organisational goals, policies and procedures.

steps.what: Retrieve actual current organisational goals, policy versions and procedure dependencies using native document links
inputs: actual policy work mandate
actual current organisational documents
outputs: scientist-checked current goals, policies and dependencies

steps.what: Interpret actual goals and develop justified policy and procedure choices
inputs: scientist-checked current goals, policies and dependencies
actual organisational objectives and constraints
outputs: scientist-developed policy choices and interpretation rationale

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final policy recommendation and exact internal decision recipients
inputs: scientist-developed policy choices and interpretation rationale
outputs: approved final policy recommendation and exact internal decision recipients

steps.what: Save the approved final policy recommendation
inputs: approved final policy recommendation and exact internal decision recipients
outputs: saved final policy recommendation

steps.what: Send the approved final policy recommendation to the approved internal decision recipients
inputs: approved final policy recommendation and exact internal decision recipients
outputs: sent final policy recommendation

tasks.design: Configure native current-version and dependency links in {DOCS}. The scientist interprets goals and develops actual policy and procedure recommendations personally. Complete final writing and approval precede separate save and internal delivery; organisational policy adoption is not inferred from a recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current policy versions and procedure dependencies may require repeated retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document links and version labels can expose exact current sources.
tasks.still_hard: Organisational tradeoffs, authority and the practical effect of a procedure.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist connects technical possibilities to actual organisational goals.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated current-policy retrieval with judgement retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document stores support native version and dependency links; this configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual policy retrieval after existing document views; existing versioning and runtime earn no saving.
Actual document owners supply document_id, version, effective_status and dependency_id. s1 retains 7.5 hours for applicability and missing documents; absent current sources use manual retrieval.

Development, interpretation and final writing remain full effort. s3 approves complete final text and recipients within the scientist actual recommendation authority. Changed versions void approval; same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which current policy and dependency retrieval remains manual?

incremental.description: Maintain actual policy dependency and current-version links

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final policy recommendation and exact internal decision recipients

tasks.short: Develop performance standards and evaluate work against established standards.

steps.what: Develop justified technical work performance standards, metrics and acceptable measurement methods
inputs: actual computing work objectives
actual quality and performance requirements
outputs: scientist-defined technical work standards and metric rules

steps.what: Verify actual work samples, test conditions and measurement completeness
inputs: actual technical work samples and test measurements
scientist-defined technical work standards and metric rules
outputs: scientist-verified technical work measurement set

steps.what: Compare exact measured results with standards using native benchmark and conformance views
inputs: scientist-verified technical work measurement set
scientist-defined technical work standards and metric rules
outputs: scientist-checked metric comparisons and measurement gaps

steps.what: Evaluate actual work quality against standards and interpret exceptions and measurement limitations
inputs: scientist-checked metric comparisons and measurement gaps
actual technical work samples
outputs: scientist technical work evaluation and limitations

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final technical work evaluation record
inputs: scientist technical work evaluation and limitations
outputs: approved final technical work evaluation record

steps.what: Save the approved final technical work evaluation record
inputs: approved final technical work evaluation record
outputs: saved final technical work evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure exact benchmark and conformance comparisons in {DATA_PLATFORM} and {BI}. The scientist develops actual technical work standards, checks measurements and evaluates work personally. The complete final evaluation is written and approved before separate storage; numeric comparison never substitutes for work-quality judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual measurements may be manually aligned to established technical metric thresholds.
tasks.enabler_now: Native benchmark views can reuse exact metrics and scientist-defined comparison rules.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing meaningful standards and interpreting work outside measured conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when a benchmark result does not reflect useful performance.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated metric comparison with standards and evaluation judgement retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: benchmark dashboards support exact metric comparison; this technical evaluation configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual comparison after current benchmark tools; existing test runs and runtime earn no saving.

The worked boundary is technical work quality, not automated employee scoring. s1 captures actual metric_id, unit, threshold, comparison_rule and test_conditions at full time. Actual work tests supply sample_id, measured_value and source_result_id; s2 retains full validity checks. s3 retains 12.5 hours for comparison exceptions; missing compatible measurements use manual evaluation.
s4 retains all judgement, s5 full final writing and approval. Changed standards or findings require renewed approval. Same-system save earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which technical metric comparisons remain manual after current benchmark views?

incremental.description: Maintain actual metric comparison and unit mappings

approvals.approved_version: s5 complete final technical work evaluation record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only metric comparison changes: 25 times 50% = 12.5 less 1 upkeep = 11.5. Low halves that benefit: 6.25 less 1 = 5.25.

tasks.short: Maintain networks, direct security measures and monitor availability.

steps.what: Review actual network availability and security observations using native consolidated monitoring views
inputs: actual network device health, availability and security logs
outputs: scientist-checked network status and investigation priorities

steps.what: Diagnose actual network faults and decide appropriate hardware, software and security measures
inputs: scientist-checked network status and investigation priorities
actual network configuration and operational constraints
outputs: scientist-chosen network maintenance and security change scope

steps.what: Prepare exact network change candidates using native configuration and patch templates
inputs: scientist-chosen network maintenance and security change scope
actual target configuration and approved patch records
outputs: scientist-checked complete candidate network change and rollback plan

steps.what: Approve the complete final network change, exact targets, maintenance window and rollback plan
inputs: scientist-checked complete candidate network change and rollback plan
outputs: approved final network change and exact target snapshot

steps.what: Apply the approved final hardware, software or security change to approved network targets
inputs: approved final network change and exact target snapshot
outputs: actual applied network change and execution findings

steps.what: Test actual network availability and security behaviour after the change and resolve exceptions
inputs: actual applied network change and execution findings
actual post-change measurements and user checks
outputs: actual verified network outcomes and unresolved issues

steps.what: Write and approve actual network maintenance, security and availability findings
inputs: actual verified network outcomes and unresolved issues
outputs: approved final actual network maintenance note

steps.what: Save the approved actual network maintenance note
inputs: approved final actual network maintenance note
outputs: saved actual network maintenance note

tasks.design: Configure native consolidated monitoring and change templates in {NETWORK_MANAGEMENT}, denoted OTHER, linked to {HELPDESK}. The scientist diagnoses, directs security choices and approves complete final changes before separate application and actual testing. Actual outcome writing and its gated save remain distinct; no autonomous production action is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual network status may be cross-checked across views and chosen configuration values retyped into change candidates.
tasks.enabler_now: Native consolidated views and exact configuration templates can reuse current source values.
tasks.still_hard: Fault diagnosis, availability tradeoffs, safe maintenance windows and verifying actual security behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when a nominally healthy metric hides a real user problem.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated monitoring and change preparation with production authority retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: network management tools support consolidated monitoring and configuration templates; this bounded configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual cross-view status checks and candidate configuration re-entry after existing network tools. Existing alerts, patch deployment, monitoring and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual devices supply device_id, observation_time, health_value and configuration_version. s1 retains 12 hours for source and status interpretation. s2 captures actual target_ids, chosen_change and maintenance_constraints at full time; s3 retains 7.5 hours for exact version, target and rollback checking. Missing compatible fields use manual preparation.

s4 approves complete final change, targets, window and rollback after the candidate exists. Target drift or changed commands void approval. Application, physical hardware work where needed and actual verification stay full effort. s7 captures actual outcomes after testing. Same-system save earns no benefit.
unknowns: Existing monitoring and change template setup
research_questions: Which monitoring cross-checks and selected configuration values still require manual re-entry?
